notes.title: Panic In the Woods Halloween update is live!
notes.content:
Panic in the Woods just got even more intense! And with 20% off during Steam's Scream Fest, it's the perfect time to grab it. :eyeballstare:

Hop on the new bus and face off against a brand new boss in a post-apocalyptic setting.

New items like the grappling hook and lasso will help you fend off zombies and other creatures. Don’t forget to team up with your friends during the ritual.  :NZA2_Pentagram:

Good luck—don’t panic! :wgm_zombie:

notes.title: Panic In The Woods OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Happy Friday the 13th!  Panic In The Woods is OUT! :ghost_shock:

Panic In The Woods, is a horror survival and extraction game where you and your friends, equipped with walkie-talkies, must rely on each other to survive as Boy Scouts lost in a creepy forest.

We hope you love it! As always, it was made with a lot of love. :)

A massive thank you to our community who joined in on the alpha testing—their feedback has been priceless. :GhostFlowerHappy:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3036880/Panic_In_The_Woods/
